screens.purpose: Give a returning shopper one obvious path to re-place their usual order.
hierarchy: SL-Nav global — inverted --sl-void surface, --sl-paper text, --sl-rule-heavy bottom
Hero band — --sl-void surface, --sl-type-display greeting, one SL-Button primary in --sl-signal, --sl-rule-heavy bottom, --sl-space-16 below
SL-Card poster — last order summary: item count and total in --sl-type-h3 with --sl-type-meta labels, delivery date row, --sl-rule-base frame
SL-Card list-item ×2 — Regulars and Search & Browse entry points, --sl-space-6 gutter, --sl-space-8 within
SL-Banner info — active delivery status line when an order is open, --sl-space-8 above

states.empty: No past orders yet. One action: START FIRST ORDER.
states.loading: SL-Card poster shows --sl-type-meta placeholder rows on a --sl-rule-hair frame.
states.error: SL-Banner error — 'Order history unavailable. Retry or search the catalogue.'

screens.purpose: Let the shopper confirm or adjust a pre-filled copy of their last order in one view.
hierarchy: SL-Nav breadcrumb — Start Order / Reorder Basket, --sl-type-meta
Screen title — --sl-type-h1 'Your basket', item count in --sl-type-meta, --sl-space-8 below
SL-Banner info — 'Filled from your order of {date}. Adjust anything below.', --sl-rule-base
SL-Input search — 'Add an item' field above the table, --sl-space-6 below
SL-Table default — one row per item: name, quantity SL-Input, price, SL-Tag status for the substitution rule, remove SL-Button ghost; --sl-rule-hair row rules
SL-Button primary GO TO CHECKOUT in --sl-signal plus SL-Button ghost SAVE AS REGULARS, --sl-rule-heavy top, --sl-space-8 above

states.empty: Last order could not be loaded. One action: SEARCH CATALOGUE.
states.loading: SL-Table default renders --sl-type-meta skeleton rows on --sl-rule-hair rules.
states.error: SL-Banner error — 'Some items are no longer sold. Review the flagged rows and continue.'

screens.purpose: Provide a fast keyword path to add the occasional item outside the usual basket.
hierarchy: SL-Nav global — inverted --sl-void surface, --sl-rule-heavy bottom
SL-Input search — full-width query field, --sl-type-body, --sl-space-8 below
SL-Tag filter ×n — category and dietary filters, --sl-space-2 gap, --sl-space-6 below
SL-Table compact — results: name, producer, price, add SL-Button ghost per row; --sl-rule-hair row rules
SL-Button ghost LOAD MORE — at the list foot, --sl-space-8 above

states.empty: No results for that search. One action: CLEAR SEARCH.
states.error: SL-Banner error — 'Search is unavailable. Reorder from your basket or retry.'

screens.purpose: Show one product and let the shopper set its substitution rule before ordering.
hierarchy: SL-Nav breadcrumb — parent screen / item name, --sl-type-meta
SL-Card poster — full-bleed image slot, --sl-type-h1 product name, --sl-type-meta producer and origin row, --sl-rule-base bottom
Price and quantity — --sl-type-h2 price, SL-Input select for quantity, --sl-space-6 below
SL-Input select — substitution rule: 'Allow suggested', 'Choose from shortlist', 'Do not substitute'; --sl-type-meta label
SL-Tag status ×n — dietary and stock labels, --sl-space-2 gap
SL-Button primary ADD TO BASKET in --sl-signal, --sl-space-8 above

states.empty: Item has no description yet — the metadata row and image slot collapse to --sl-type-meta 'DETAILS TO FOLLOW'.
states.loading: SL-Card poster shows a --sl-rule-hair image placeholder and --sl-type-meta label rows.
states.error: SL-Banner error — 'This item could not be loaded. Return to the basket.'

screens.purpose: Collect the delivery slot and confirm the order in one screen with no surprises.
hierarchy: SL-Nav breadcrumb — Reorder Basket / Checkout, --sl-type-meta
Screen title — --sl-type-h1 'Checkout', --sl-space-8 below
SL-Card data — delivery slot picker: a day list, each day carrying a morning and an afternoon window with an SL-Tag count for remaining capacity; --sl-rule-base frame
SL-Table compact — order summary lines, each showing its substitution rule as an SL-Tag status; --sl-rule-hair rules
SL-Card data — totals block: subtotal, delivery, total in --sl-type-h2 with --sl-type-meta labels
SL-Input text — optional delivery notes, --sl-type-meta label
SL-Banner warning — shown only when an item still has no substitution rule set, --sl-space-6 above
SL-Button primary PLACE ORDER in --sl-signal plus SL-Button ghost BACK TO BASKET, --sl-rule-heavy top, --sl-space-8 above

states.empty: Basket is empty. One action: START ORDER.
states.loading: Slot list and totals render --sl-type-meta skeletons on a --sl-rule-hair frame.
states.error: SL-Banner error — 'Payment was not authorised. Check the card and place the order again.'

screens.purpose: Give the shopper one ETA they can trust and the time it was last confirmed.
hierarchy: SL-Nav breadcrumb — Account / Order {id}, --sl-type-meta
Hero band — --sl-void surface, --sl-type-display delivery date, SL-Tag status ON TRACK or DELAYED, --sl-rule-heavy bottom
SL-Card data — half-day window and 'last confirmed {time}' line in --sl-type-h3 with --sl-type-meta labels
SL-Banner warning — proactive delay notice carrying the new date, shown only when the ETA has moved, --sl-space-6 below
SL-Table default — order lines, each showing its final substitution outcome as an SL-Tag status; --sl-rule-hair rules
SL-Button primary VIEW SUBSTITUTIONS in --sl-signal when swaps await approval, otherwise SL-Button ghost, plus SL-Button ghost CONTACT SUPPORT, --sl-space-8 above

states.empty: No active order. One action: REORDER LAST ORDER.
states.loading: Hero band and SL-Card data show --sl-type-meta placeholder text.
states.error: SL-Banner error — 'Live tracking is unavailable. Your delivery date is unchanged; retry for live status.'

screens.purpose: Let the shopper accept, replace, or drop each proposed swap before the van is loaded.
hierarchy: SL-Nav breadcrumb — Order {id} / Substitutions, --sl-type-meta
SL-Banner info — 'Answer these before {cutoff}. Anything left follows your saved rule.', --sl-rule-base
SL-Card data ×n — per swap: original item and proposed item paired, price delta in --sl-type-meta, --sl-rule-base frame, --sl-space-6 gutter
Per card — SL-Button ghost ACCEPT, SL-Button ghost CHOOSE OTHER, SL-Button destructive REMOVE ITEM, --sl-space-2 gap
SL-Modal dialog — CHOOSE OTHER opens a shortlist of in-stock alternatives as SL-Card list-item rows, --sl-rule-hair rules
SL-Button primary CONFIRM ALL in --sl-signal, pinned at the foot, --sl-rule-heavy top, --sl-space-8 above

states.empty: No substitutions proposed. One action: BACK TO ORDER.
states.error: SL-Banner error — 'Your choices were not saved. Saved rules still apply; retry to override.'

screens.purpose: Let the shopper curate the item set that seeds every future reorder.
hierarchy: SL-Nav sidebar — account sections, --sl-rule-hair divider
Screen title — --sl-type-h1 'Regulars', --sl-space-8 below
SL-Card data — 'Your regulars seed every reorder' explanation in --sl-type-body, --sl-rule-base frame
SL-Table sortable — regular items: name, typical quantity SL-Input, last ordered in --sl-type-meta, remove SL-Button ghost; --sl-rule-hair rules
SL-Table compact — past orders: date, item count, total, reorder SL-Button ghost per row; --sl-rule-hair rules
SL-Button primary BUILD BASKET in --sl-signal, --sl-rule-heavy top, --sl-space-8 above

states.empty: No regulars saved. One action: ADD FROM LAST ORDER.
states.error: SL-Banner error — 'Regulars could not load. Reorder from history below or retry.'

design_system_gaps.need: A selectable day-by-window delivery-slot grid, showing remaining capacity per cell and enforcing a single choice.
design_system_gaps.why_insufficient: SL-Card data can frame the picker but models no cell selection, no single-select constraint, and no per-cell capacity state; SL-Table has row rules but no selectable-cell affordance.

design_system_gaps.need: A compact three-state substitution-rule control repeated inline on every basket and checkout row.
design_system_gaps.why_insufficient: SL-Input select works as a standalone field but is too heavy to repeat on every table row; the implied segmented toggle is display-only in SL-Tag, which is defined for status, filter, and count, not input.

design_system_gaps.need: A persistent order-status object that carries the current ETA, its last-confirmed timestamp, and whether it has changed.
design_system_gaps.why_insufficient: SL-Banner is transient page messaging, not a durable status surface; SL-Tag status shows the state label but not the timestamp or the fact that the ETA moved.
